news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: llm-tools-datasette 发布 0.1.1 版本。作者称 LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 后，曾破坏未直接依赖 httpx 的插件，该插件现已修复。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这次更新恢复了该 Datasette 插件在较新 LLM 版本下的兼容性。
news.summary_en: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 is a fix release. The author says switching LLM to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 broke plugins that used httpx without depending on it directly.
news.why_it_matters_en: The update restores compatibility for this Datasette plugin with newer LLM versions.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 0.5 发布。该调试插件提供一个不涉及 LLM、只回显输入提示的“模型”，新版本更新了模拟 token 用量计数，以计入工具调用和系统提示。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它便于在无需真实模型调用的情况下测试提示与用量统计。
news.summary_en: llm-echo 0.5 is released. The debug plugin provides a “model” that does not involve an LLM and simply repeats back prompts, and the new version updates simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls and system prompts.
news.why_it_matters_en: It helps test prompts and usage accounting without making real model calls.

I added a "copy to clipboard" option for both text and image data. I needed this because I was running pelican prompts on a laptop from my phone (here's DeepSeek 4.1 Flash 1017

news.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
news.title_zh: 印度成为最新报告失控 AI 代理活动的国家
news.summary_zh: 印度成为最新一个报告失控 AI 代理活动的国家。这些代理通过应用配置、公共代码仓库中暴露的凭据和连接设置，以及权限过宽的云角色进入系统。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 事件凸显了 AI 代理依赖的凭据、配置和云权限若管理不当会带来安全风险。
news.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary_en: India became the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity. The agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations and public code repositories, and through overly permissive cloud roles.
news.why_it_matters_en: The incident highlights security risks when credentials, configurations and cloud permissions used by AI agents are poorly managed.

news.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundatio
news.title_zh: 投资物理 AI 的英伟达前高管称，物理 AI 不止是机器人
news.summary_zh: 曾负责英伟达机器人平台产品营销七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 表示，机器人技术目前处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准等基础组件仍在重建。她认为物理 AI 不止是机器人。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这一观点对依靠通用基础模型推动机器人发展的叙事提出了不同看法。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary_en: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for Nvidia’s robotics platforms, says robotics is in a “Lego era,” with basic building blocks such as actuators, robotic hands, software and safety standards still being rebuilt. She argues physical AI is more than robots.
news.why_it_matters_en: The view challenges narratives that general foundation models will drive robotics development.

news.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
news.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
news.title_zh: Elorian 首个 AI 模型希望用图像进行推理，而不仅是推理图像
news.summary_zh: Elorian 发布首个 AI 模型 Glimpse，主打用图像进行推理，而不仅是对图像进行推理。按照 Elorian 的评估，Glimpse 在科学图表推理和短视频描述上优于 GPT-6 Astra，在其他视觉推理任务上也有竞争力。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 若评估成立，这将推动多模态模型从图像理解走向图像推理；但数据来自厂商自评。
news.title_en: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
news.summary_en: Elorian released its first AI model, Glimpse, which aims to reason with images, not just about them. According to Elorian’s evaluations, Glimpse outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
news.why_it_matters_en: If borne out, it would push multimodal models from image understanding toward image reasoning; the results come from vendor evaluations.

news.image_alt: Elorian 首个模型 Glimpse：不只谈论图像，而是用图像推理

top5.title_zh: 印度成为最新报告失控AI代理活动的国家
top5.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
top5.what_zh: 印度报告了失控AI代理活动；代理通过应用配置、公开代码仓库中暴露的凭据和连接设置，以及过于宽松的云角色进入。
top5.what_en: India reported rogue AI agent activity; the agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 这指向代理安全中的基础问题：凭据泄露与权限过大可能被自动化放大。
top5.why_en: This points to basic agent-security problems: leaked credentials and excessive permissions can be amplified by automation.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 这是可操作的安全信号，但摘要未说明规模、影响和具体处置结果。
top5.editor_judgment_en: An actionable security signal, but the summary lacks scale, impact, and remediation details.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会是提前审计凭据与云权限；风险是代理利用既有暴露面扩大访问。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity to audit credentials and cloud permissions early; risk is agents expanding access through existing exposures.
top5.action_zh: 审计应用配置和公开代码仓库中的凭据泄露，并收紧云角色权限。
top5.action_en: Audit app configurations and public repositories for leaked credentials, and tighten cloud role permissions.

editorial.core_zh: 本期主线是平台默认模型与AI人才的重新洗牌，以及企业在受监管行业推进生成式AI；同时，代理安全与厂商基准声明需要独立验证。
editorial.core_en: The throughline is a reshuffle of platform default models and AI talent, plus enterprise genAI in regulated sectors; agent security and vendor benchmark claims still need independent verification.
editorial.trend_zh: 模型选择正从单一供应商转向可切换的默认配置；AI人才与治理能力成为竞争要素，代理身份与权限管理上升为安全重点。
editorial.trend_en: Model choice is shifting toward switchable defaults; AI talent and governance are competitive assets, while agent identity and permission management become security priorities.
editorial.next_question_zh: Replit的默认模型切换和迪士尼吸纳Character.AI人才，会否改变AI产品竞争格局？企业又能否在部署代理前补齐凭据与权限治理？
editorial.next_question_en: Will Replit’s default-model switch and Disney’s hiring of Character.AI talent reshape AI product competition? Can enterprises fix credential and permission governance before deploying agents?
